label: The mode-of-being pair is equivalent to: a total cause of being causes every actual perfection
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. Over the shared frame and for any total-cause relation: the pair 791fa216 and 2f6b9eff, existentially closed over the primitive ModeOfBeing, is equivalent to the composite: a total cause of a thing's being causes each perfection that thing has in act. This is an instance of a general logical fact about any two-premise decomposition through a middle term, and it certifies nothing about warrant by itself. What it shows for this case is that, since in every registered consumer ModeOfBeing occurs only in its pair and no independent fixing of it beyond the act-of-being thesis is on file, the pair carries the composite's load; which member carries it depends on the reading of mode of being (on the constitutive reading 2f6b9eff is near-analytic). It asserts neither premise.
